1.19 Measure workers without disturbing a real job

Worker count is a measurement, not a core-count rule. HDD seeks, compressed metadata output, ExifTool startup, decoded arrays, database ownership and cache warmth can dominate different phases. Measure a representative, disposable archive scope and compare full extracted values, not just throughput or counts.

The retained benchmark scripts cover native metadata timing, metadata memory, byte verification and the Turso metadata workflow. They write measured inputs, backend choices, typed-value checks and tool hashes to reports. They are research tools with explicit archive/year/filter arguments, not automatic tuning services. Run their --help before selecting a scope.

uv run python benchmark_metadata_workers.py archives/years --year archive-a/2023
uv run python benchmark_metadata_memory.py archives/years
uv run python benchmark_byte_workers.py archives/years --year archive-a/2023
uv run python benchmark_turso_metadata.py archives/years --year archive-a/2023 \
  --path-contains /selected-album/ --dataset leica

The timing benchmark requires 18 selected DNG source/reference pairs and tests worker counts 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 18, 24 and 36. --path-contains explicitly narrows relative paths. The memory benchmark uses the prior timing report’s exact input paths. The Turso --dataset value labels the result; it does not verify a camera model or select a private camera tree. These scripts still sample live source bytes and create archive-side research outputs, so only run them on a scope you intend to read.

The optional live-job benchmark mode uses SIGSTOP/SIGCONT on a declared owned process tree to isolate a trial. Only opt into that after understanding the selected PID and its descendants. A stopped process can retain locks or an unfinished transaction; stopping an arbitrary Lightroom, database or copy process is unsafe. A Python finally attempts resumption during ordinary cleanup, but SIGKILL, a crash or machine shutdown can prevent it. The public benchmark mode requires an explicit pause option and validates the process’s ownership and preservation command. Prefer an idle machine and no live PID.

RSS reports sample processes and ExifTool descendants; summed RSS can count shared pages more than once and does not equal unique physical memory. A warmed short metadata trial is not cold multi-terabyte HDD throughput. Report worker count, files, bytes, codec/layout strata, wall time, cache state and whether the measurement includes extraction, compression, indexing and validation.
